subject: Concept MARL: demo scope decisions
body:
Team,

Decisions from Monday's review, aimed at the 7/20 close:

1. Demo environment: Collaborative Cooking only. Nikhil's June probe results (87% concept recovery on cooking vs 78% on Clean Up) make cooking the defensible showcase; Clean Up and Capture the Flag move to the Q3 backlog.
2. Rewards: we demo the sparse-reward agents. Quentin's concern was right — the interpretability story is the whole product pitch, and an asterisk kills it. Dense-reward runs stay as a training-efficiency appendix.
3. The LRB packet leads with the concept-probe dashboard; Umar owns the eval card in Evalline by 7/15, Nadia's office gets the packet 7/16.

Good half, team — this went from paper to demo in fifteen weeks.

Ulla
